INDEPENDENT · UNOFFICIAL FIELD GUIDE

Azeroth Survivors co-op and multiplayer

Last updated: November 14, 2026

Field guide

What is Azeroth Survivors?How to playBuildsTier listDownload & fixesSafety checkTalent treeLuck

To play with friends, select your hero in Aethus’s original game and open Play with friends. One person hosts the lobby and starts the run. Everyone else joins with their own selected hero.

Before the host enters the zone

  1. Compare the version shown on each player’s game screen. Reload an old browser tab or let the desktop client update if the versions differ.
  2. Pick the zone and difficulty as a group. Check the unlocks on the heroes that will actually join the run.
  3. Create the lobby and share its code and optional password privately. The host should wait for the party list and any Ready Check responses before entering.

Find the step that is holding up the party

What you seeWhat to check
A friend cannot use the lobby codeConfirm the game version, the code and password, and that the host is still in the lobby.
The party is stuck on Ready CheckAsk each player to bring the game forward and respond. Confirm the zone and difficulty if anyone declines.
The run started while someone was joiningPlan to regroup for the next run. Send the code before the host enters and wait for everyone to appear.
Movement looks choppy with three or more playersCheck for the v0.143.2 update on browser clients. Aethus’s release note describes smoother remote hero movement during brief connection stalls.

Lobby names and descriptions in v0.143.3

If a lobby name loses decorative characters, use letters, numbers and ordinary punctuation. The new release accepts letters from different languages. It also fixes an issue where one long word in a description could disrupt the lobby list.

  • Aethus’s current browser release manifest
  • Aethus’s v0.143.3 announcement

Recover together after a disconnect

If a guest returns to the lobby list, use party chat or your group chat to check whether the host is still in the run. If the group needs a fresh attempt, regroup in the lobby and confirm the selected heroes before entering again.
